entities.summary: Christopher Douglas Estes is a former King Diamond bass player (1994–1999). Originally from Dodge City, Kansas, Estes moved to Denton, Texas, in 1991 to attend the University of North Texas as a Jazz Studies major. During his time at UNT he met Darrin Anthony Stull and joined his unsigned Dallas band Mindstorm. During the next three years Mindstorm played the Dallas club scene and eventually caught the attention of Danish singer King Diamond, who had recently moved to the DFW area and was looking for new members for his solo act.
